name: Voice ~Kimi no Kotoba ni Boku o Nosete~
original_name: Voice ～君の言葉に僕をのせて～
source:
Heterographers are people who can manipulate language and create powerful word forms with almost magical effect capable of summoning spirits. 

This is a school where a lot of heterographers are gathered. There is fighting and a lot of mysterious events happening. Feng Hong transferred to such school in pursuit of his first love. What will these events conclude with?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“异文师”是一类能够驾驭语言的人。他们可以凝聚出具有强大力量的文字形态，其效果近乎魔法，甚至能够召唤精灵。

这所学校汇聚了众多异文师，校内不仅争斗不断，还接连发生各种神秘事件。凤薰为了追寻初恋对象转入此校。这一切最终将通向怎样的结局？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
